name: Kahua
summary: An owner-and-contractor construction management platform with a bid management module that ties released bids to budgeted resources.
differentiator: Aimed at large, complex capital programs with formal approvals; the vendor claims 2,500+ customers and 70,000+ projects. Bid packages link to the budget, which suits owners and GCs running multi-party programs. It is more platform than a contractor needs to send ten invitations a month.
pricing: No public list price. Third-party listings disagree (one cites $690 per user, another from $49 per month), so treat both as unreliable and get a quote.
whoPays: Owner or GC pays; quote only
bestFor: Owners, program managers and large GCs running multi-party projects.
skipIf: You want a light bid tool for a small team.
